product.title: Full-day Customizable Private Seoul Highlight Tour

description.text: In Seoul, this private eight-to-nine-hour circuit pairs an English-speaking driver-guide with an air-conditioned vehicle and hotel pickup. The published suggestion covers Gyeongbokgung Palace, Insadong, and Bukchon Hanok Village, with a hanbok rental listed as an add-on for palace photographs and lunch on the suggested plan. Entrance fees follow the booked option. The format suits visitors who want a single guided city sweep without assembling palace tickets and neighborhood transfers independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Seoul, and the itinerary stays on Gyeongbokgung, Insadong, and Bukchon that define this outing rather than a DMZ crossing.
